trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no separate task to chase: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Plan around the long tail instead — the story, then the 100% Completion checklist behind A Long Road, then the collectible and activity cleanup. No online play and no DLC are needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy comes naturally in the first session — just follow the mission prompts until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the first meditation when it is offered at Jason's house — that spot is the one missable step in the whole list (see Positive Mental Attitude), and it disappears once Chapter 1 is over.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Nothing in this chapter is missable: keep scanning vehicles and studying animals through binoculars as you travel, because that progress already counts toward the 100% Completion checklist later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is opening up, so use the travel between missions to explore new areas — exploring all 52 areas of Leonida is its own trophy (The Goodtime State) and feeds the completion checklist.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter before the finale, so before moving on, mop up any side-contact missions that are open — the contacts' final missions each carry their own trophy and stay available in free-roam afterwards, but clearing them now keeps the endgame tidy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final mission after Chapter 4 and see it through to the end. It is the only gold story trophy. Once it pops, free-roam continues, the 100% Completion checklist becomes viewable, and everything not yet earned can be cleaned up without replaying missions — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so just keep playing the chapter missions in order; no extra objective is needed beyond finishing the mission itself.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist mission: follow it to its conclusion and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is awarded for finishing that one mission — keep playing the story in order and it will come.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Treat each range as a short, repeatable drill: learn its target pattern first, then go for the gold time or score. There is no mission replay to worry about here — ranges can be retried as often as you like in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission as the story presents it; the trophy is tied to completion, not to a score or a special objective inside it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is a main-story mission at the airport — play it through to the end and the trophy follows automatically.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission in the story flow; no side task is required for this trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion on the in-game checklist, which opens at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, after the story ends. It is the hardest trophy, but the bar is lenient — roughly 60% true completion. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, plus the story and the other checklist items. Progress made before the checklist opens still counts, and nothing on it is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all feed the count. Do them opportunistically while travelling between missions instead of grinding them in one sitting, and keep an eye on the progress counter so you know when you are close.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Check the full list at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and work through any type you have not touched yet — one try each is enough, no win or high score is required.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location needs its own win, so treat it as a tour: finish one, move to the next, and do not assume a win at one place covers another.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word — winning the same race again does not add to the count. Vary the race type and location, and check your race progress between sessions so you do not repeat a win by accident.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the side activities tied to Cal, so find his challenge, learn what it scores — usually size or count in a time window — and retry until you out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you find easiest, play through it, and the trophy pops when the game is completed, not just started.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's side missions until his final one appears, then complete it. Side contacts hand out their missions over the course of the story, so check back with Andy between chapters rather than expecting all of his missions at once.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's side missions until his final one appears, then complete it. Like the other contacts, his chain opens up gradually — keep returning to him as the story advances.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's side missions until his final one appears, then complete it. His chain is a side story, not a main chapter, so it is easy to leave half-finished — track it in this guide and finish it before the endgame cleanup.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as side encounters around the map — each strand is a short chain, not a single errand. Explore off the main roads, answer the stranger prompts, and finish each chain you start.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's side missions until his final one appears, then complete it. Keep checking in with Randy between story chapters so his chain does not stall.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's side missions until his final one appears, then complete it. His chain, like the other contacts', is spread across the story — finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter — do it the first time it is offered, before finishing Chapter 1. Every other spot can be done later in free-roam, so the only step you cannot recover is that first one.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points you at a specific animal — follow his lead, track it, and take it down. Study animals through binoculars on the way: that progress counts toward the 100% Completion checklist too.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you explore and keep a note of which sets are nearly done — finishing a set is what counts, not the raw number of cards held.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a long grind, so fold it into your normal travel: WAiNK at each new place you visit rather than saving all 100 for the endgame.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% Completion checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. Pick the easiest challenges first across the categories and skip the hardest ones — you have 30 to spare.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the heat and escape together. Plan a route out before you start — losing the wanted level is the hard part, so use quiet roads and break line of sight rather than fighting it out.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together, plan the route in advance, and move fast — the streak breaks if the heat drops, so do not stop to fight or hide mid-run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles counts toward this and toward the 100% Completion checklist, which needs 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned — so keep scanning every new vehicle you see, starting in the story, and this trophy will come well before the checklist is done.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group clustered together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the effect ends — a lone enemy or a spread-out group will not give you five in time.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport — leave the airport in a vehicle that is not part of a scheduled flight. In practice that means taking off from the airport grounds in something you grabbed there; once you are airborne and away, the trophy should pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. The description is deliberately vague — the trophy is tied to tanks, so engage a Rhino in the open world and deal with it rather than avoiding it. No guide has pinned down a single required method yet, so treat any Rhino encounter as the chance and check the trophy after it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet, move slowly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out and try again rather than fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a full robbery job: get in, open the vault, and get clear before the heat closes in. Count them as you go — five completed escapes, not five attempts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo, and get clear before the wanted level catches up with you. Plan your escape route before you hit it — the escape is part of the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Travel the whole map, not just the mission routes — drive, fly and walk into every named area until the counter is full. Areas you pass through during the story count, so this mostly finishes itself if you explore between missions.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough — you need all nine, so keep a list of which gangs you have already hit and do not repeat a gang while another is still untouched.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned down how this unlocks yet — the description implies a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but do not invent steps from it. Watch for a prompt or a venue on Ocean Beach that offers a drink with a view, and check for updates to the PowerPyx guide before spending time hunting for it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned down how this unlocks yet — the description implies smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but the exact showroom and trigger are not confirmed. Do not invent a location from the description alone; check the PowerPyx guide for an update before attempting it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through there — in other words, play a full game of bowling at that alley. The trophy is tied to that specific alley, not to bowling anywhere, so make sure you are at the Kolt & Associates lanes.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. Guide from the description only: it is a partnership moment, likely with your partner, that draws a crowd or a public reaction. Do not invent a location or step; check the PowerPyx guide for an update.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500 for this trophy. That count is the in-game choices you make over a full playthrough, for better or worse, so it builds up naturally as you play. Keep playing through story and side content and it will tick over; it is not a single decision.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No guide has pinned down how this unlocks yet — the description implies succeeding on a second try at something, but which attempt and where are not confirmed. Do not invent a step from the wording alone; check the PowerPyx guide for an update.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No guide has pinned down how this unlocks yet — the description implies witnessing something strange or unexpected in the world. Do not invent a location or event from the wording alone; check the PowerPyx guide for an update before hunting for it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned down how this unlocks yet — the description implies knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact target and setup are not confirmed. Do not invent steps; check the PowerPyx guide for an update.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and your contacts are the way to clean them — keep laundering as you earn them and the total builds up over the playthrough. You do not need to hold $250,000 at once; it is the total laundered.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. It is cumulative spending, not a single purchase — buy weapons, clothes, food and other shop goods as you play and the total climbs. If you are close at the end, top it up with a few large shop purchases.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida — keep an eye out for property markers as you explore, and buy each one when you can afford it. You need all eight, so do not stop at seven.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them through the app — ten different vehicles, not ten registrations of the same one. Scanning vehicles for the checklist overlaps with this, so work on both together.
trophies.name: On the Spot
